svg.title: Educational CPU reference · not an Unreal capture
svg.desc: This is the original educational CPU path tracer rendered from the checked-in linear PFM. The burned-in bitmap footer is removed; the caption below is native SVG text. It is NOT an Unreal scene, NOT an Unreal capture, and NOT the matched path-traced reference.

g.text: Image: reference_linear.pfm → path_tracer.py tone map at exposure 0.6.
PFM rows reversed bottom-up → top-down; the original PNG footer is not included.
Image region checked against original PNG rows 0–164; footer rows 165–199.
Lambertian-only CPU scene; the tall right block is deliberately diffuse, not the Unreal glossy block.
NOT Unreal. NOT a substitute for the matched Lumen / path-traced reference pair.
